Mass-produced tsurugi are inferior to true-forged ones. Common knowledge at present. Also a fact beyond doubt.

But suppose the mass-produced machine has a total capacity of eight. The Racer Crus spends all eight on speed and maneuverability. The true-forged machine has ten, but five go to combat, five to mobility.

Now conduct a race. Five is supposed to beat eight how? By seniority?

Too much arithmetic in this analysis, perhaps. In practice, though, the difference really is that large.

Through the S-curves.

Very safe flying, even if I say it myself.

This is not praise. Racing technique means balancing speed and safety on the very edge. That skill I do not have. So speed has been discarded. Safety remains, doing all the work.

For the audience, nothing entertaining. I can do nothing about it, so their forgiveness is requested.

The leader is nearly half a lap ahead now. The gap continues to grow; shrinking is not in its present intentions. Both the golden machine and its rider seem in good form.

What to do?

Perhaps stop chasing and deliberately let them lap me. Being near the racers is the actual requirement.

...Not a solution at the root.

Near them for a little while, then left behind again. With our speed so much lower, staying close is simply not possible.

Then change the whole approach?

Ignore the course and fly...?

One method, certainly. But if that is treated as abandoning or obstructing the race, we are out. Nor can I ignore the considerable trouble it would bring the police team.

Is there no better way?

Ｓ字カーブを抜ける。
　我ながら、危なげのない騎航だ。

　全く褒め言葉ではないが。
　サーキットコースにおける速度と安全を限界の一線
で両立させる<ruby>競技騎航技術<rt>レーシングテクニック</rt></ruby>の持ち合わせがないため、
速度を切り捨てて安全を取っているだけの話である。

　観客にしてみれば面白くもなんともあるまい。
　どうにも仕様がないので、勘弁して貰うしかないが。

　先頭からの遅れはそろそろ半周になろうとしている。
現在進行形で伸張中であり、縮まる気配はまるでない。
黄金騎は騎手も騎体も調子が良いようだ。
　どうしたものか。

　この際無理に追うのはやめ、あえて周回遅れになる
べきかもしれない。要は選手達に近接できればそれで
良いのだ。
　……根本的解決とは言い難いが。

　一時的には近付けても、また引き離されれば同じ事。
　こちらの速度が大きく劣っているという事実がある
以上、騎手達と至近距離を保つという希望はどうにも
成立しない。

　いっそ発想の転換が必要か。
　コースを無視して飛ぶなど…………？

Conclusion: for this situation, no use.

No wind remains.

The air has gone somewhere else. This is that sort of place.

Refreshing.

Magnificent.

...Mazak nahi hai. This is no joke.

Even armour racing does not contain this world. Going there will solve what, exactly?

Grip that vortex of energy, like a boiling waterfall.

Consciousness burns white-hot. The bridge between the halves of my brain bursts. Left and right split apart. I am torn into two.

Hold it down—
